title: Final bot (HandHQ exploit pack) vs three blind red-team bots

sets.single: seven copies of one red-team bot
sets.multiples: red-team bots only, mixed in multiples (4+3 and 3+2+2)
sets.population: one of each red-team bot plus four pop-v1+handhq-v1 validation members
sets.previous: red-team bots plus our previous bots (blueprint-only, nlhe-v2, previous-final)

hypotheses.primary: For each of the 21 cells, H0: the final bot's mean terminal points per tournament = 12.5 (par for 8 seats). Two-sided paired-block t-test (blocks are seed blocks with all 8 seat rotations), Holm across the 21 cells at alpha 0.05.
hypotheses.classification: Per cell and per set from the 95% interval of the final bot's mean points: LOSES when the upper bound is below 12.5, WINS when the lower bound is above 12.5, otherwise BREAK-EVEN (not distinguishable from par at this sample size).
hypotheses.secondary: The final bot minus each reference arm (blueprint-only, nlhe-v2, previous-final) on the same seeds, per cell and per set, with 95% intervals (paired by block).

attribution.note: Exploratory and descriptive: each rule below flags a behaviour as implicated in a LOSES or BREAK-EVEN cell; none is a causal claim.
attribution.overbet: OVERBET implicated when, in the cell's pooled tables, the hero folds at least 10 points more often to a red-team post-flop overbet than to a red-team bet of up to one pot, AND the hero's chips per hand (big blinds) in hands where it was live when a red-team seat overbet have a 95% bootstrap interval entirely below zero, with at least 30 overbets faced.
attribution.bubble: BUBBLE implicated when the hero's summed points-equity change over hands that start with 4 or 3 players alive is negative with a 95% bootstrap interval entirely below zero, and the red-team seats' preflop 3-bet, 4-bet and shove rate per hand dealt is higher at 4 or 3 players than at 6 or more.
attribution.image: IMAGE implicated when an adaptive opponent is in the cell and the hero's chips per hand (big blinds) against it differ between its tight and loose phases with a 95% bootstrap interval for the difference excluding zero.
attribution.reference_contrast: Every rule is also evaluated for the three reference arms on the same seeds, so a behaviour that hurts every bot equally is reported as such.

stopping: Block counts are fixed above. No cell is rerun with new seeds to change a result. A different bundle is run with the same seeds (paired across bundles); a bot tuned on these results must be evaluated with a new base_seed.
smoke: Smoke runs for timing and bug-finding use base seed 'redteam-smoke' only; their results are not read for hypotheses.
